subject.title: feat(macos): redesign Share This Mac sheet with custom deck-style controls

question: Should Crabfleet adopt this custom deck-style Share This Mac sheet as the permanent native macOS interaction design after the branch is refreshed onto current main?
rationale: The diff is a substantial deliberate visual and interaction-language redesign with no supported mechanical defect to repair; only a maintainer can decide whether this design direction belongs in the product.

options.title: Adopt after refresh
options.body: Require a rebase onto current main and land the redesign if the resulting signed-bundle review confirms the custom controls match the intended macOS product direction.

options.title: Keep native controls
options.body: Decline the visual direction and retain the current stock-control presentation if platform familiarity is preferred over the deck-style design system.

recommendation.title: Adopt after refresh
recommendation.body: Require a rebase onto current main and land the redesign if the resulting signed-bundle review confirms the custom controls match the intended macOS product direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed recent contributor across the merged share-sheet predecessor and this redesigned implementation.
